capabilities: Generate QR codes in notes via a qrcode code block
Generate customizable codes with a qrcode-complex keyword
Set width, margin, and dark/light colors
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render QR codes from text or links inside a note.

relations.evidence: The library used for generating QR Codes is node-qrcode.

summary: Generates QR codes in notes from a qrcode code block, with options for size, colors, margin, and error correction level.
